overview_description.description:
Kashier is a payment management platform for commerce and retail businesses that provide tools used for running a business.

The toolkit covers subscriptions to invoices and online payments and is built with the capability to meet the rapidly evolving needs of today’s fast-growing businesses, from small startups to large enterprises.
